units.source_text: 家里倘使有四个小孩，弄得乱七八糟的，那可是不得了。

en.t: When there are four children at home and they make a terrible mess, it really is something awful.

units.source_text: 我整天得跟着他们收拾。

en.t: I have to spend the whole day picking up after them.

units.source_text: 虽然明知收拾好，还会给弄乱的，但总得去管它，否则放心不下。

en.t: Even though I know perfectly well that once I tidy things up they will only be scattered again, I still have to see to it, or I cannot feel at ease.

units.source_text: 只要环境许可，我还是想生活得干净些。”

en.t: As long as my circumstances allow it, I still want to live a little more cleanly.”
